from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single cash flow data point from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name (e.g., '东阿阿胶股份有限公司')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Period covered by the report (e.g., '2015 Q1', '2015 Jan-Sept')")
    data_type: str | None = Field(description="Type: 'Q1 single quarter', 'Jan-Sept cumulative', etc.")
    cash_received_from_investment: float | None = Field(description="Amount of 'cash received from investment income' for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., '元')")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="Financial statement type: 'consolidated' or 'parent company'")
    year_over_year_amount: float | None = Field(description="Same metric from previous year period, if provided in document")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief description of where this data comes from in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_records: list[CashFlowDataPoint]
